request: a simple interactive ascii color mixing engine
thesis: Colour mixing made tangible with nothing but characters: a grid of glyphs whose density and hue are the mix, so you see paint behave as text.
job: open the page and see a populated ascii canvas at once
mix them: change amounts/ratios and see the blend result
see the result as ascii glyphs coloured, plus a swatch and hex/rgb readout
switch mixing model (additive light vs subtractive paint) to see the difference
copy or read the resulting colour

principles: additive RGB: light sums toward white
subtractive CMY: pigment absorbs toward black/brown
linear-light blending differs from naive sRGB averaging (gamma)
mix by weighted average of channels, weights sum to 1
tricks: subtractive mix approximated by multiplying normalised channels
gamma-aware mix: square channels, average, sqrt
tests: weights 100/0 returns the source colour exactly

principles: glyph density stands in for brightness
monospace cells are ~1:2 so squash vertically
colour carries hue, character carries value
tricks: batch same-colour runs into spans for speed
line-height 1 and letter-spacing tuned so cells are near square

tests: moving a slider changes the readout and canvas

principles: one state object, one render function
tricks: pre element with innerHTML of spans

kinds.name: blend field
kinds.what: a grid where each cell is a mix of sources by position, with sliders for source weights and a model toggle

kinds.name: palette mixer
kinds.what: pick two colours, ascii gradient strip between them

kinds.name: paint-by-glyph
kinds.what: drop colour blobs on a canvas that blend where they meet

descriptions: three sources A B C with weights
result = weighted blend in chosen model
gamma toggle shows why naive averaging looks muddy
behaviors: raising one weight pulls the result toward it
field cells interpolate by position between sources

descriptions: controls beside the field on desktop, stacked on phone

anti_keywords.not: layer stacks, undo history, save/export formats, accounts
anti_keywords.instead: one screen, mix, read the result

anti_keywords.not: photo upload or image to ascii
pure RGB slider app with a flat swatch
anti_keywords.instead: make the glyph field the star

checks: red 100% shows pure red result and red cells
red+green additive reads yellow, subtractive reads dark
phone width has no horizontal scroll
